sentences.text: 2. The petitioners state that they are the owners of land measuring 03 guntas in survey No.50/1P of Appasandra Village, Kolar Taluk, Kolar District.

It is submitted that the respondents have notified the land by virtue of Notification under Section 28(1) of the KIAD Act for the purpose of formation of industrial area and subsequently Final Notification came to be issued under Section 28(4) of the KIAD Act.

It is submitted that the petitioners were not in receipt of any notice regarding possession or payment of compensation and it has come NC: 2023:KHC:23899 to their knowledge that the general award has been passed as per proceedings at Annexure-A on 20.12.2013.
3.

It is further submitted that the petitioners were interested in opting for a higher rate of compensation under the package scheme if they were notified regarding the said option of compensation by way of agreement under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act, prior to passing of general award.
The petitioners have opted for compensation under agreement.
Accordingly, the petitioners submit that the general award may be set aside and compensation be determined in terms of agreement under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act.

Observations made in W.P.No.6198/2015 is relied upon, which reads as follows:
"Petitioner is assailing the General Award dated 30th December 2013, Annexure-A,
of the 3rd respondent-Karnataka Industrial Area Development Board (for short 'KIADB') insofar as it relates to 1 acre 39 guntas in Sy.No.444 of Cheeluru village,
Maralavadi Hobli, Kanakapura Taluk, Ramanagara District, on the premise that her claim for NC: 2023:KHC:23899 determination of compensation ought to be by way of an agreement under Sub-section (2) of Section 29 of the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Act, 1966 (for short 'KIAD Act') since willing to the enter into an agreement after having obtained a compromise decree dated 6.12.2014 in O.S.126/2013 whereunder the property in question is declared to be the absolute property of the petitioner.
2. Sub-section (2) of Section 29 of the 'KIAD Act' provides for determination of compensation by an agreement and in the light of the compromise decree whereunder, the property in question has fallen to the exclusive share of the petitioner, is entitled to such a consideration, since it is stated that by such an agreement, petitioner would be entitled to a better price as compensation instead of determination under a general award, while acquisition proceeding would attain a finality disentitling petitioner to challenge the same in this petition.
In the circumstances, there is a need to interfere with General Award Annexure-A insofar as it relates to petitioner's land.
3. In the result, this petition is allowed.
General Award Annexure-A insofar as it relates to petitioner is concerned is quashed.

A direction shall ensue to respondent-KIADB to consider the case of the petitioner for determination of compensation by NC: 2023:KHC:23899 way of an agreement under Section 29(2) of Smt. Mangamma vs The State Of Karnataka on 11 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90104883/
3

sentences.text: the 'KIAD Act' to be complied with as expeditiously as possible within an outer limit of 31st October 2015.

It is made clear that this order is applicable only if there is no dispute to title in the immovable property acquired and if there is one, the General Award in respect of petitioner is concerned shall stand restored until the dispute is resolved."
4. In the light of the above, the General Award at Annexure-A dated 20.12.2013 is set aside.

Respondent No.3 to consider the request of the petitioners to avail compensation by way of agreement under Section 29(2) of the KIAD Act under the package scheme and pass necessary orders within a period not later than three months from the date of release of this order.
5. Respondent No.3 is at liberty to withdraw the amount lying in deposit as regards the General Award, which is now set aside.
In the event of any dispute, the General Award would stand restored.
In the light of the above, petition is disposed off.
